question: SIGN of the NW gas displacement relative to the NW mass along the NW->S2 infall axis
headline: ALL 88 (mass tracer x axis) pairs give Delta_lead < 0: the gas sits OUTWARD of the mass. No pairing and no axis definition gives a leading gas core.

s3_kill_conditions.cond_2_result: FIRES 4-fold on AX_A: WSLAP+/Diego (free-form) -319.2, SaWLens/Merten (free-form) -314.1, Merten+2011 WL -409.6, Medezinski+2016 WL -171.3

most_conservative_pairing.mass: UNCOVER v2.0 North-West-2 halo / NW-BCG2 (the NEAREST mass peak to the gas)
most_conservative_pairing.gas: Chandra 2.1621 Ms NW interloper peak, this work
most_conservative_pairing.note: mass->gas offset is anti-parallel to the inward axis to within 2.8 deg

gas_positions.source: THIS WORK: all 102 ObsIDs of Chandra CDC 257 (DOI 10.25574/cdc.257), 2.1621 Ms, 975070 events 0.5-2 keV, 2 arcsec/pix TAN, no exposure correction
validations: 728 kpc NW of the main peak vs Owers+2011 "~750 kpc"
83.9" from the Medezinski+2016 NW WL peak vs published 87 (+34,-28) arcsec
140 kpc / 385 kpc from the two NW mass peaks vs Merten+2011 ">150 kpc for NW2" / "at least 400 kpc" for NW1
gas_positions.positional_stability: rms 1.1" (main) and 1.3" (NW) over 5 smoothing scales x 3 data splits; worst excursion 4.6"

lensing_quarantine: NOT ENGAGED. No ESD, no shear profile, no stacked contrast, no Sigma_crit weighting was computed. Only argmax locations of published maps plus spherical trigonometry.
structural_findings: Chadayammuri+2024 state that in their FIRST-INFALL scenario "the BCG is always well aligned with the subcluster X-ray peak", and on that basis "our binary simulations therefore disfavour a first-infall scenario for NW". Their first-infall verdict rests on TRIPLE-merger cool-core survival, not on the offset. The measured -133 kpc is therefore a datum the adopted scenario does NOT predict.

WL and SL disagree on the NW mass position by ~70 arcsec = 317 kpc. All four lens models put it on the NW BCGs; the Medezinski Subaru WL peak is 68 arcsec north of the nearest NW BCG. This moves |Delta_lead| from 171 to 307 kpc on AX_A - it does NOT move the sign.
The NW substructure is TWO objects 47 arcsec = 213 kpc apart. The gas lies between them in projection: 140 kpc from NW-2, 385 kpc from NW-1. Both are emitted; there is no single "NW mass peak".
S2 is never given a coordinate in Chadayammuri+2024. Both candidate identifications are emitted as separate axes (AX_A/AX_B vs AX_C/AX_D); they differ by 0.6 deg in axis PA and <1 kpc in Delta_lead.

The Medezinski+2016 "X_c positive = West" sign convention, previously flagged as INFERRED, is now VERIFIED by measurement against the published merten_v1 kappa map (W clump reproduces to 6 arcsec under West, 350 arcsec off under East).

DELIVERY DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED: every URL in chandra_cdc257/cdc257_retrieval_urls.txt returns HTTP 404. The cgi-gen/cda/retrieve5.pl endpoint no longer exists (404 even with no query string). Corrected file with 102 verified URLs written alongside.

The TNG Cluster Mergers catalogue is ~20 MB, not a heavy-compute job - but it contains NO gas field at all, so a gas-lead census cannot be derived from it. It is blocked behind an API-key 403 regardless.
